```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r load-upstream}
outdir <- analysis_file("04_TF_NLR_network")
```

```{r}
high_conf_edges <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("04_TF_NLR_network", "Candidate_TF_NLR_edges.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(
    EvidenceScore >= 3,
    TF_NLR_abs_cor >= 0.80,
    TF_DE_LRT == TRUE | SameModule == TRUE
  )

cat("High-confidence edges:", nrow(high_conf_edges), "\n")
cat("TFs:", n_distinct(high_conf_edges$TF_gene), "\n")
cat("NLRs:", n_distinct(high_conf_edges$NLR_gene), "\n")

write_tsv(
  high_conf_edges,
  file.path(outdir, "High_confidence_TF_NLR_edges_relaxed.tsv")
)


nodes <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("04_TF_NLR_network", "Cytoscape_TF_NLR_nodes.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

high_conf_nodes <- nodes %>%
  filter(Gene %in% unique(c(high_conf_edges$TF_gene, high_conf_edges$NLR_gene)))

write_tsv(
  high_conf_nodes,
  analysis_file("04_TF_NLR_network", "High_confidence_TF_NLR_nodes.tsv")
)
```
```{r}
nlr_hub <- read_tsv(
  analysis_file("NLR_centered_coexpression_network", "NLR_seed_hub_ranking.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

tf_target_rank <- read_tsv(
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_NLR_regulatory_target_ranking.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

core_nlr_candidates <- nlr_hub %>%
  select(
    Gene,
    Coexpr_HubRank = HubRank,
    Type,
    Module,
    Coexpr_Degree = Degree,
    Coexpr_WeightedDegree = WeightedDegree,
    abs_kME,
    max_abs_log2FC,
    main_response_time,
    direction_at_max
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    tf_target_rank %>%
      select(
        Gene,
        TF_TargetRank = NLR_TargetRank,
        TF_InDegree = InDegree,
        TF_WeightedDegree = WeightedDegree
      ),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Coexpr_HubRank, TF_TargetRank)

write_tsv(
  core_nlr_candidates,
  file.path(outdir, "Core_NLR_candidates_coexpression_and_TF_network.tsv")
)

core_nlr_candidates
```
```{r}
top_core_nlr <- core_nlr_candidates %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(Gene)

final_tf_nlr_edges <- high_conf_edges %>%
  filter(NLR_gene %in% top_core_nlr) %>%
  transmute(
    Source = TF_gene,
    Target = NLR_gene,
    EdgeType = "TF_to_NLR_candidate",
    TF_family,
    TF_name.x,
    NLR_Type,
    Motif,
    Correlation = TF_NLR_cor,
    abs_cor = TF_NLR_abs_cor,
    Direction = CorDirection,
    EvidenceScore,
    EvidenceClass,
    SameModule,
    TF_DE_LRT,
    TF_module,
    NLR_module,
    qvalue_Tomtom,
    FIMO_best_pvalue,
    Motif_enrichment_FDR
  )

write_tsv(
  final_tf_nlr_edges,
  file.path(outdir, "Final_core_TF_NLR_edges_for_Cytoscape.tsv")
)

final_nodes <- tibble(
  Gene = unique(c(final_tf_nlr_edges$Source, final_tf_nlr_edges$Target))
) %>%
  mutate(
    NodeType = case_when(
      Gene %in% final_tf_nlr_edges$Source ~ "TF",
      Gene %in% final_tf_nlr_edges$Target ~ "NLR",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  final_nodes,
  file.path(outdir, "Final_core_TF_NLR_nodes_for_Cytoscape.tsv")
)
```

```{r display-key-results, results='markup', echo=FALSE}
show_table(
  tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "High_confidence_edges",
      "High_confidence_TFs",
      "High_confidence_NLRs",
      "Core_NLR_candidates",
      "Final_core_TF_NLR_edges"
    ),
    Value = c(
      nrow(high_conf_edges),
      dplyr::n_distinct(high_conf_edges$TF_gene),
      dplyr::n_distinct(high_conf_edges$NLR_gene),
      nrow(core_nlr_candidates),
      nrow(final_tf_nlr_edges)
    )
  ),
  n = 20,
  title = "Core TF-NLR export summary"
)
show_table(high_conf_edges, n = 30, title = "High-confidence TF-NLR edges")
show_table(core_nlr_candidates, n = 30, title = "Core NLR candidates from coexpression and TF network")
show_table(final_tf_nlr_edges, n = 30, title = "Final core TF-NLR edges for Cytoscape")
show_table(final_nodes, n = 30, title = "Final core TF-NLR nodes for Cytoscape")
```
